simple.summary: הִתּוּךְ (hittûwk) means a melting First listed occurrence: Ezek 22 22.

definitions.full: H2046. hittuk הִתּוּךְ noun [masculine] a melting (Hophal-formative, dissimilated from הֻתּוּךְ , according to Ba NB § 102 d ); — construct כּוּר בְּתוֺךְ כֶּסֶף כְּהִתּוּךָ Ezek 22:22 like a melting of silver in a smelting-pot .
